---
title: "duree_cycle"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

```

Importer les données
```{r}

hiver <- read_excel("Climatic_Winter_problème.xlsx") |> 
  select(1:3) |> 
  rename("debut" = `date de début en pratique`, 
         "fin" = `date de fin en pratique`) |> 
  separate(col = lieuXannee, 
           into = c("lieux", "annee"), 
           sep = "(?<=\\D)(?=\\d)") |> 
  mutate("duree_hiver" = fin - debut) |> 
  mutate("nb_jours" = as.numeric(yday(debut) - make_date(year(yday(debut)), 9, 1)))

hiver |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = annee, y = duree_hiver, colour = lieux)) +
  geom_point()

hiver |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = annee, y = as.numeric(yday(debut) - make_date(year(yday(debut)), 9, 1)), colour = lieux)) +
  geom_point()

```
